title: Ransom note from magazine
statement_markdown: Given two strings `ransom_note` and `magazine`, return `True` if `ransom_note` can be constructed by using the letters from `magazine` and `False` otherwise. Each letter in `magazine` can only be used once in `ransom_note`.
starter_code:
def can_construct(ransom_note: str, magazine: str) -> bool:
    pass
hints: Count the characters in both strings.
explanation: Count character frequencies in the magazine. Subtract frequencies for each character in the ransom note. If a frequency drops below 0, return False.
complexity: O(n + m) time and O(1) space (alphabet size).
